cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(foundation_vulkan_hdr LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT WIN32 OR NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Vulkan HDR compatibility tools require Windows x64")
endif()
add_library(zako_vulkan_hdr_bridge SHARED tools/vulkan_hdr_bridge/vulkan_hdr_bridge.cpp)
add_executable(vulkan_hdr_probe tools/vulkan_hdr_probe/vulkan_hdr_probe.cpp)
foreach(target IN ITEMS zako_vulkan_hdr_bridge vulkan_hdr_probe)
  target_compile_features(${target} PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
  target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE user32)
  set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES
    PREFIX "" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bin"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bin"
    MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
  if(MINGW)
    target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -static -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++)
  endif()
endforeach()
if(MINGW)
  target_link_options(vulkan_hdr_probe PRIVATE -municode)
endif()
target_link_libraries(vulkan_hdr_probe PRIVATE advapi32)
configure_file(tools/vulkan_hdr_bridge/VkLayer_zako_virtual_hdr.json bin/VkLayer_zako_virtual_hdr.json COPYONLY)
configure_file(LICENSE bin/LICENSE COPYONLY)
configure_file(source.json bin/source.json COPYONLY)
